source_claim: AliceSoft's official character materials for Beat Angel Escalayer, Choukou Senin Haruka, Choukou Shinki Ixseal, and Choukou Taisen identify every character in this packet as belonging to its Choukou works.
notes: AliceSoft's official Beat Angel Escalayer character page names Escalayer, Koenji Sayuka, Koenji Madoka, and Yanase Kyohei (https://www.alicesoft.com/escalayer/chara.html). Its official Choukou Senin Haruka roster names Takamori Haruka and Shihoudou Narika (https://www.alicesoft.com/haruka/character.html). The official Choukou Shinki Ixseal page names Ellis Xillia and Houshou Kirika, says Kirika becomes the second Shinki called Kyriel, and identifies Oudo Tsuguhiko in its character profiles (https://www.alicesoft.com/ixseal/sp/chara/index.html). Official AliceSoft Choukou Taisen materials name Ichinose Yurippe (https://www.alicesoft.com/information/2025/entry003583.html), Haruhina Urara (https://www.alicesoft.com/information/2025/entry003693.html), and Sonozaki Akari (https://www.alicesoft.com/information/2020/entry002650.html). The source pages establish these exact people and transformed identities in AliceSoft's Choukou titles; no unrelated crossover-only association or fan roster is used.
